perception.note: Low light vision, Scent 30ft imprecise, Tremorsense 30ft imprecise

defensiveAbilities.name: Hold Tight
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature Grabbed by the holdfast's jaws takes damage from another creature's Strike

Effect The holdfast Constricts the creature in its jaws.

defensiveAbilities.name: Lithe
defensiveAbilities.description: A holdfast treats any tight space it can barely fit its head in or wider as difficult terrain and doesn't need to Squeeze to move through it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Burst from Below
offensiveAbilities.description: The holdfast Burrows and then Strikes. If the holdfast began this movement Hidden, it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(2d6+2) Piercing Damage plus crush throat, Basic DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crush Throat
offensiveAbilities.description: When a creature fails a save against the holdfast's Constrict, the creature's throat is held tight, stopping them from speaking as long as they're Grabbed. This prevents the creature from casting spells with vocal incantations, as well as from using many sonic or auditory abilities.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
